up: List all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5726934 that have a SMILES string. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, name, and SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726934' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
